issues_confirmed: GameTheoryIMATMT/Bayes_Player.py:34 - off-by-one in the TitForTat likelihood. A TFT opponent's move at round t-1 copies the agent's move at round t-2, so this must compare opponent_move against self.history[-2]; it compares against self.history[-1], which only tests whether both players happened to play the same action in the same round. The 2026-09-21 review called this line correct - it is not.

GameTheoryIMATMT/Bayes_Player.py:30 - cooperation_ratio is computed over self.history (the agent's own actions) and then used at :40 as evidence about the opponent's type; the belief update is partly self-confirming.

GameTheoryIMATMT/Bayes_Player.py:46 - recent_defections counts the agent's own defections as evidence for ThresholdBased, and the guard len(self.history) > 5 around a [-5:] slice forces it to 0 for the first six turns.

GameTheoryIMATMT/Bayes_Player.py:13-22 - strategy_categories maps categories to opponent class names, but the lists are never read anywhere in the file; only the dict keys and len() are used. Many names are invented and absent from Axelrod (GrimTrigger, Forgiver, Stochastic_TitForTat, ForgivingTitForTat, FriendlyGrudger, RiskyCooperator).

GameTheoryIMATMT/Bayes_Player.py:53-58 - likelihoods are pinned at 0.1/0.9 with no floor, so priors decay geometrically and lock near zero permanently; combined with Turns = 10 at :91 (nine updates) the posterior cannot converge, so the experiment's horizon is too short to test its own hypothesis.

GameTheoryIMATMT/Bayes_Player.py:99-104 - results record only scores, never max(self.priors, key=...), so the run cannot answer whether the opponent's type was identified - the only question main_question.md asks.

GameTheoryIMATMT/HPC/ai_player.py:48 - response[-PLAYS:] takes the last 50 characters of the decoded output, which still includes the echoed prompt because the input ids are never stripped; :53 maps anything that is not literally "C" to Defect, making the LLM player a defect-heavy random player.
GameTheoryIMATMT/tournament.py:21-25 - result dicts set "Strategy" to opponent.name and "Opponent" to scores[0] (a score under a name key); strategy.name and scores[1] are never recorded.

GameTheoryIMATMT/HPC/plots.py:15 - results[row[0]] = int(row[1]) keys a dict by name across a ~240x240 loop, silently keeping only the last match per name, and row[1] holds a score mislabelled as Opponent by tournament.py.

GameTheoryIMATMT/Strat_per_strat.py:70-77 - while True exits only on ai_response == "✅" while the prompt at :43 asks for "Y✅", and the response is the full decoded prompt+completion; the condition can never fire. :74 would raise TypeError anyway (strategies is a list indexed by strategy name), and :19 passes device_map="none", not a valid value. It fails first at :29 reading results/Strategy_Guide_results.json, which .gitignore excludes and which is absent.
GameTheoryIMATMT/Initial_match.py:81 - module-level reference to i, which is local to the loop inside plot_results; NameError after all ~57,600 matches have run.

GameTheoryIMATMT/Initial_match.py:25-26 - total_scores accumulates both players for every ordered pair, so each unordered pairing is counted twice and self-matches add both scores to the same key; the ranking is roughly 2x inflated. The whole loop reimplements axl.Tournament single-threaded.

GameTheoryIMATMT/main.sh:15,25 and Strat.sh, BayesPlayer.sh, Initial_match.sh - all four SLURM scripts are copy-pasted from an ANSYS Fluent CFD template, carrying 'module load fluent' and '--licenses=anshpc:176' on a PyTorch job, plus '#SBATCH -D /users/adgz422'.

Game_theory.py:14-23 - CustomStrategy.strategy falls off the end and returns None for the first two rounds, and the class is never entered into the tournament (:28 uses axl.strategies); First_game_strategies at :29 is unused.
Plot_Basic.py:33 - Slider(chosen_strategies, ...) passes a list of Player objects where an Axes is required; TypeError on import.
trial.py:67 - ax.set_size_inches(8, 6) calls a Figure method on an Axes; AttributeError every run. Scores at :11 are np.random.randint dummies.

Horizontal_Bar_Plot.py:83 - a verbatim StackOverflow PyQt5 scroll-plot demo over np.cumsum(np.random.randn(...)); no bar chart and no game theory, and it builds a second QApplication at :75 after __init__ already made one at :18-21.

Repo-wide - axelrod is not installed, there is no requirements.txt and no venv, and the ambient python3 (3.14.4) has no pip; every .py fails at import axelrod. GameTheoryIMATMT/.python-version says AIRun and .3.11.11 / .python3.11.11 both say myenv, naming virtualenvs that existed only on the cluster.
Process - the 2026-09-21 review's five tasks were accurate and none were acted on; the only commit since is the review commit 5ce0c23 itself.
